title: Connected system
subtitle: Where WhatsApp bookings go: Weline's built-in booking or the system your business already uses
forbiddenDescription: You don't have permission to view the connected system.
saveForbidden: You don't have permission to change the connected system.
saveFailed: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
readOnly: You can see the connected system but not change it.

providerDescriptions.builtin: Appointments are kept in Weline. Set up your clinic in Clinic and Bookings.
providerDescriptions.cliniko: Bookings go straight into your Cliniko diary.
providerDescriptions.google_calendar: For businesses without a booking system: your services, staff and hours are set up in Weline, busy times come from your Google Calendar, and bookings are added to it.
providerDescriptions.microsoft_365: The same with an Outlook calendar in Microsoft 365 (work or school accounts): busy times come from the mailbox's calendar and bookings are added to it.
providerDescriptions.calendly: If you take bookings with Calendly: patients get a Calendly link to book or move, and Weline reads your Calendly bookings for reminders (ask for the mobile number as Calendly's text reminder) and can cancel them.

fields.calendar_id: Calendar ID (Google Calendar → Settings → Integrate calendar)
fields.tenant_id: Microsoft 365 tenant ID (filled in after approving)
fields.mailbox: Mailbox whose calendar Weline books into (e.g. bookings@yourbusiness.com.au)
fields.api_token: Personal access token (Calendly → Integrations → API and webhooks)

consent.help: Your Microsoft 365 admin approves Weline once. You'll come back here with your tenant filled in.
consent.approved: Approved. Now enter the mailbox and test.
consent.refused: Weline wasn't approved in Microsoft 365. Ask your Microsoft 365 admin to approve it.
consent.expired: That approval link expired or wasn't valid. Start again with Approve Weline in Microsoft 365.
consent.taken: This Microsoft 365 tenant is already connected to another Weline account. Contact Weline support.

switchNote: Switching changes where new WhatsApp bookings go. Appointments already made stay where they are.
